environment.server: uvicorn, 1 process, --ws websockets, --log-level warning, permessage-deflate on (default)

method.bytes: WebSocket payload as Chromium reports it (no frame header, before permessage-deflate)
method.gzip: gzip -6 of each downloaded file, computed by the benchmark (neither server compresses)

loc.rule: Counted: the files a person writes for the feature (the server's handlers, the templates or the client, the page). A line counts when it has code on it: blank lines, comment-only lines and Python docstrings do not.
